observations: Wall-mounted salon hair dryer unit with a white body and black hood/air duct.
Control panel on the front with two knobs/switches and indicator lights (exact specs not readable).
Brand text appears on the front label: “MANGO” (photos show it, but model/voltage not clearly readable).
Power cord is visible hanging from the unit/arm area (no plug type shown clearly).
No close-up photos of the motor housing, intake filter, or any rating plate/serial number.

claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Brand “MANGO” is visible on the front label in photos 0-3; the unit is wall-mounted and looks like a salon dryer.

claims.claim: 6 months of use and in a very perfect condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show no obvious cracks/damage, but usage time and “perfect condition” cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No purchase date/receipt details are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: No motor inspection/serial/diagnostic or proof of non-opening is shown.
No receipt/warranty card photos are provided.

claims.claim: I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: No new photo/video of the test (running/heat/airflow) was provided to verify the claim.

risks.risk: Not actually working as claimed (heater/airflow weak, intermittent power, or fan/motor issue). Photos can’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video of the dryer running from cold to hot with airflow visible, plus a close-up of the control settings being changed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs repair or doesn’t heat properly).

risks.risk: Wrong voltage/frequency for Nigeria or incompatible plug (could still run but not safely/efficiently).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/label showing voltage (V), wattage (W), and frequency (Hz), plus a photo of the plug end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially requiring adapter/verification (worst case: not suitable without electrical work).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts or loose wiring (hood/duct, mounting bracket, or internal connections).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mounting bracket connection points and the underside/side where the cord enters, showing no loose wires.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as complete but with unknown internal integrity (worst case: may need parts).

risks.risk: Reduced heat performance (unit may run but not reach proper temperature).
risks.proof: Video showing it heating effectively (e.g., timed warm-up) and a thermometer reading near the outlet if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as average/unknown performance (worst case: reduced heating).

proof_requests: Short running video from cold showing airflow and heat while changing settings.
Photo of the rating plate/serial number (voltage, wattage, Hz) and the plug end.
Photos of receipt and warranty card (clear enough to read dates/serial).
Close-up of cord entry and mounting bracket attachment points.
response.reason: The seller’s statement that they tested it is not verifiable remotely without a new running/heat video or rating-plate/plug photos. Key price drivers (working/heating performance, voltage suitability, completeness) remain unproven.
